sidebar.title: Grids & settings
sidebar.author: Author (optional)
sidebar.canvasHint: Place categories anywhere and resize them freely, like the in-game hero grid. Portraits shrink to fit their box.
sidebar.canvasLeaveBody: This erases the canvas coordinates and aligns everything back onto the grid, doing its best to keep the arrangement: rows, order, widths and portrait sizes are derived from how the canvas looked. It cannot be undone.
sidebar.canvasEnterBody: Categories keep their current arrangement as a starting point, then you can move and resize them freely.
sidebar.optAdjustSizes: Adjust portrait sizes to match the canvas
sidebar.canvasConverted: Converted the canvas into a classic grid

confirm.clearBody: Every category and portrait on this grid will be removed. This cannot be undone.
confirm.deleteGridBody: "{name}" will be removed from your saved grids. This cannot be undone.

view.empty: This grid is empty. Switch to Edit to add categories.

edit.addCategoryHint: Add a category to start building your grid.

print.hint: Scaled to fit a single page. Enable background graphics in the print dialog to keep the colours.

autogrid.sortRoles: Order roles by how much I play them
autogrid.personalHint: Steam Account ID (Dota friend ID). Match history has to be public.
autogrid.noMetaLevels: This report can't produce meta levels
autogrid.replaceSame: Replace grids with the same name
autogrid.failed: Could not load the stats report
autogrid.pickOne: Pick at least one grid to generate
